aggressive_definition: Aggressive prostate cancer; the abstract does not provide an operational stage, grade, metastatic, or lethality definition.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: We obtained the following novel findings: high-level organ meat intake was an independent predictor for increased aggressive PCa risk; supplementary iron, copper and magnesium increased benign PCa risk; and the AA diet was "healthy" in terms of the relatively lower protein and fat levels and was "unhealthy" in that it more commonly contained organ meat.
study_design: Cox proportional-hazards regression analysis of PLCO Diet History Questionnaire data.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We performed a unique analysis of the Diet History Questionnaire data of 41 830 European Americans (EAs) and 1282 African Americans (AAs) in the PLCO project.
reason: The abstract reports overall PCa risk analyses and an exposure-specific aggressive PCa risk analysis for organ meat. It does not operationally define aggressive PCa or explicitly describe the study as a prospective cohort in the abstract.
